title: Larkfield Cash Price List for Ostomy Supply Program Items
content:
The Larkfield cash price for Ostomy Supply Program items is stated per billing unit, in USD, and is the same on every payer tier (Ostomy Self-Pay Program, Ostomy Commercial HMO Program, Ostomy Commercial PPO Program, Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program, Ostomy Original Medicare Program, Ostomy Medicaid Program).

| Item | Description | Cash price per billing unit (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| A4414 | Flat skin barrier with flange 4x4 in or smaller | 9.85 |
| A4407 | Extended-wear skin barrier with built-in convexity | 12.40 |
| A4409 | Extended-wear flat skin barrier | 11.20 |
| A4416 | One-piece closed pouch with filter | 4.95 |
| A4423 | Two-piece closed pouch for a locking-flange barrier | 3.10 |
| A4424 | One-piece drainable pouch | 7.60 |
| A4427 | Two-piece drainable pouch | 4.25 |
| A4431 | One-piece urinary pouch with tap | 8.35 |
| A4434 | Two-piece urinary pouch with tap | 5.05 |
| A4406 | Pectin-based paste, per ounce | 6.80 |
| A4455 | Adhesive remover, per ounce | 3.40 |
| A4367 | Ostomy belt | 14.50 |
| A4357 | Bedside drainage bag | 6.90 |

A billing unit is each barrier, pouch, belt or bedside drainage bag, and one ounce of paste or adhesive remover.

*Hypothetical illustration:* 10 units of A4423 at the cash price of USD 3.10 each come to USD 31.00; 2 ounces of A4406 at USD 6.80 per ounce come to USD 13.60.
